title: Geometric component of polynomial formal fibre
statement: intermediate theorem used to prove formalFiber_isGeometricallyRegular

proof.text: The completed polynomial local ring is Noetherian; its r-fibre is Noetherian.

For each finite purely inseparable residue-field extension, obtain a finite product presentation in terms of linear-residue polynomial formal fibres over complete Noetherian local coefficient domains.

For this linear case, the coefficient map to the completed polynomial local ring is local, by contraction of the maximal ideal. The completion is formally smooth, hence this coefficient map is regular. Its fibre at zero is geometrically regular; test the trivial field extension and transport along the tensor unit isomorphism to obtain regularity of the coefficient generic fibre.

The linear-fibre presentation gives an element and an absolute derivation taking value one, with its quotient isomorphic to the required fibre. One is a unit also after quotienting. Apply the hypersurface derivation criterion and transport regularity through the ring equivalence.

A finite product of these regular rings is regular. Use Mathlib PrimeSpectrum.exists_comap_evalRingHom_eq to select the factor of any prime, then Localization.AtPrime.mapPiEvalRingHom_bijective identifies its localization with that factor’s localization. Transport regular locality with IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv. Mathlib supplies Noetherianity of the finite product. Thus IsRegularRing holds for the product, and the ring equivalence in the presentation transports it to the extended fibre. This argument also covers the empty product.

lean.statement: theorem formalFiber_isGeometricallyRegular_component (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A] (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) [CharP (Localization.AtPrime (⊥ : Ideal A)) p] (q : Ideal (Polynomial A)) [q.IsMaximal] (hq : q.comap (Polynomial.C : A →+* Polynomial A) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) (r : Ideal (Polynomial A)) [r.IsPrime] (hrq : r ≤ q) (hr : r ≠ ⊥) (hrA : r.comap (Polynomial.C : A →+* Polynomial A) = ⊥) : let C := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q)) (Localization.AtPrime q) Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular r.ResidueField (r.Fiber C)
